headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Texas Rangers, with Joc Pederson leading the way for the losing team with 2 hits and 2 home runs. The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Coby Mayo leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Rico Garcia earned the save and also recorded 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to a left knee meniscus tear. Kerry Carpenter has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers with left foot plantar fasciitis. Cody Bellinger has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Yankees with a left hamstring strain.

There have been several trades and roster moves in the past day. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The San Diego Padres signed Nu'u Contrades. The St. Louis Cardinals traded Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox traded Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for Curtis Mead.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Rangers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Texas Rangers, with Joc Pederson leading the way for the losing team with 2 hits and 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Tigers 8-5**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Coby Mayo leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Rico Garcia earned the save and also recorded 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Mason Montgomery earning the win. Max Kepler led the Diamondbacks' offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Walk Off in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins edged the Philadelphia Phillies 8-7 in a back-and-forth game. Heriberto Hernández led the Marlins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Reds in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with José Ramírez and Kyle Manzardo contributing key hits for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Down Orioles in Dominant 14-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing win over the Baltimore Orioles, finishing the game with a 14-0 score. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Kerry Carpenter, while the Orioles' Jackson Holliday and Kevin McGonigle also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Casey Schmitt on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants left fielder Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The injury occurred on July 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rodríguez Traded to Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: Johnathan Rodríguez has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Baltimore Orioles acquired cash in exchange for the right fielder.
